purpose: Implement the existing EG-CONCURRENCY and EG-RESOURCE runners for the active xtask tooling scope without application behavior or Qualification Cell advancement.

change.public_seam: cargo xtask quality returned verdict and immutable target/quality/evidence report

dependency_review.rationale: The implementation uses only Rust std bounded sync channels, threads, queues, and existing reviewed xtask dependencies.

runner_changes: The active xtask scope selects only the existing EG-CONCURRENCY and EG-RESOURCE risk gates; all gate IDs, stages, budgets, coordinators, exception classes, cells, and product scopes remain unchanged.

FrozenQualificationFixtures captures concurrency-fixtures.tsv once, binds its bytes into fixture, seed, and schedule identities, and supplies those same immutable bytes to both runners and retained evidence.

EG-CONCURRENCY registers three Quality Engineering workers before Builder::spawn, gives each a one-command bounded channel, cooperative cancellation token, and shared bounded measurement channel, sends concrete cancellation or work commands, reserves bounded cancellation and join time inside the one monotonic 100ms runner deadline, and records completion only after JoinHandle::is_finished plus join only after that exact handle returns successfully. The public gate runs this thread owner inside the existing controlled process owner with a 75ms work budget and the remaining 25ms reserved for forced termination and direct-child reap, so a truly noncooperative worker cannot keep cargo xtask quality alive past the registered bound.

EG-RESOURCE performs real FIFO work admission, two-unit reservations, hard-pressure denial, a two-attempt retry storm bound, reservation release, queue-empty and leak checks, and three observed worker joins. The verifier independently requires exact one-to-one registered worker IDs, exact joined IDs, and unique contiguous schedule slots before deriving fairness from the observed order.

concurrency-spawn-sites.tsv declares stable path, symbol, kind, and semantic site IDs. The focused concurrency source-policy module tokenizes production tooling source with comments and literals excluded, masks only complete cfg(test) items before resuming production scanning, resolves simple, grouped, nested, multiline, aliased, and transitively rebound Rust use/value bindings, denies direct generic and imported unbounded spawn or queue primitives, accepts bounded sync-channel aliases and rebindings, and fails closed if observed semantic sites are duplicate, stale, missing, or newly unregistered.

M0-08 public-seam tests are physically separated into scanner-policy and lifecycle/resource modules with shared fixture support; the unrelated evidence-staging publication race repair is outside issue 9 and is not part of this policy change.
unchanged: No application, runtime, Metrics, Profiles, replication, clustering, distribution, or provider behavior is added.
Developer evidence remains diagnostic and non-merge-eligible. Every Qualification Cell remains Specified; this harness implementation is Implemented only.
No dependency, unsafe boundary, threshold, timeout, memory declaration, selector, test command, or existing gate behavior is weakened.

detection_gained: Selecting either newly active gate executes a concrete bounded runner and retains a named immutable outcome instead of returning unsupported-runner failure.

An unregistered direct spawn, direct generic unbounded channel, forbidden primitive hidden through a grouped, nested, aliased, or rebound value binding, production spawn after a cfg(test) item, duplicate semantic registration, stale semantic registration, capacity drift, excess retries, pressure bypass, missing cancellation, missing observed join, duplicate or non-contiguous schedule slot, non-FIFO schedule, or residual reservation fails closed through cargo xtask quality.

The immutable report identifies the frozen scenario, schedule, seed, one registered deadline, total deadline elapsed time on failure, exact completed and joined worker IDs, cancellation delivery state, controlled process termination and reap state for noncooperative workers, hard pressure, retry limit, leak result, bounded shutdown, and independent verifier result.

lifecycle_test_map.pass: quality_runs_concurrency_and_resource_through_the_registered_public_seam verifies passed named outcomes and immutable reports.
lifecycle_test_map.fail: quality_rejects_an_unregistered_tooling_spawn_site_through_the_public_seam and quality_rejects_a_stale_semantic_spawn_site_through_the_public_seam retain failed EG-CONCURRENCY outcomes; quality_rejects_resource_capacity_drift_through_the_public_seam retains a failed EG-RESOURCE outcome.
lifecycle_test_map.timeout_and_cancellation: Gate-specific proof: the concurrency scenario uses one monotonic 100ms registered bound from work through cancellation, completion observation, exact join, process termination, direct-child reap, failure measurement, and return. Cooperative workers retain cancel-delivered, already-queued, disconnected, completed, joined, elapsed, and live state. quality_reaps_a_noncooperative_worker_process_inside_the_registered_bound injects a truly infinite worker, then proves typed deadline, termination-requested, process-reaped, elapsed at most 100ms, and live=0 evidence through the public gate seam.
lifecycle_test_map.retry_and_resource: The resource scenario records hard pressure at capacity two, limits retries to two, releases all reservations, independently requires exact worker identity and unique contiguous schedule slots, and verifies FIFO order and empty queue state.
lifecycle_test_map.missing_tool: Gate-specific proof: these hermetic Rust std runners introduce no external tool dependency. Shared M0-06 proof: environment snapshot and controlled launch-failure tests preserve missing-tool failures before external detector execution.
lifecycle_test_map.malformed: The frozen concurrency fixture parser rejects bounded registry size, header, field-count, finite integer, duplicate gate, and spawn-site violations before execution; shared M0-06 fixture/evidence parser tests retain malformed report and registry proof.
lifecycle_test_map.stale: Gate-specific proof: the stable semantic spawn-site registry must match every observed source marker exactly, so stale or duplicate registrations fail before work runs. Shared M0-06 evidence identity checks cover stale revision, command, environment, raw report, and registry digest bindings.
